instruction: Configure Courier New as the default typeface for all new Writer documents

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the default font in LibreOffice Writer to Courier New. The evaluator checks the registrymodifications.xcu configuration file to verify the default font setting has been changed to 'Courier New'. This uses the existing find_default_font metric function.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary scoring: 1.0 if default font is set to Courier New, 0.0 otherwise

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly reads the LibreOffice configuration file (registrymodifications.xcu) which is the persistent location for default font settings
Function find_default_font correctly navigates XML structure using XPath to find /org.openoffice.Office.Writer/DefaultFont/Standard property
Correct string comparison logic: extracts font name from XML and compares against expected value 'Courier New'
Complete coverage: evaluator checks the exact requirement from the instruction (default font for Writer documents)
State is accessible: config file persists after task completion, no postconfig needed
Expected value 'Courier New' correctly matches the instruction requirement
Edge cases handled: returns 0 if config file is missing or font doesn't match
